name: io.github.plastic-labs/engram
title: Engram
description: Memory that reasons: continual learning for stateful agents. Better context, fewer tokens.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Authorization header for Engram. Use either an OAuth access token or a Engram API key from https://app.engram.dev (API keys start with hch-). Send as: Bearer <token>.

headers.name: X-Engram-Workspace-ID
headers.description: Optional. Default Engram workspace for tool calls. When set, it fills workspace_id on tools.
